note: The verdict per base engine config class AEE can override. Authored from the engine override surface reference (docs/wiki/research/engine-override-surface-reference.md). A class is silent here only if it is not a base engine class. The validator tools/validation/validate_engine_overrides.py checks this file and the generated headers.

surfaces.source: data/ballistics/loads.json: service_velocity_ms (grade documented, US military specifications and TM 43-0001-27) with the manufacturer velocity table as the fallback (grade claimed, Hornady and Lapua).
surfaces.reason: initSpeed is a plain scalar. The real cartridge muzzle velocity moves the engine's own projectile from the muzzle.
surfaces.ceiling: Load-time and global. The PBO is the only off switch.

surfaces.source: None held. The corpus holds tracer rounds as projectiles and loads but no per-magazine tracer ratio.
surfaces.reason: The real 4:1 ball-to-tracer ratio is a LINKED-BELT property. A magazine is either all ball or all tracer, so the ratio does not map to a magazine scalar without inventing a figure. The vanilla config already sets tracersEvery to 0, 1, 4 or 5 per magazine.
surfaces.ceiling: No committed source for a per-magazine ratio. A belt ratio is a modelling choice, not a measured magazine property.

surfaces.source: Derived from the held ballistic coefficient and standard drag curve: data/ballistics/projectiles.json (bc_g1 or bc_g7, measured or documented) and data/ballistics/sources/drag_functions.json (JBM and McCoy).
surfaces.reason: The engine applies quadratic drag a = airFriction * v^2. The verified AEE drag model states the same form with 0.00068418 * (Cd / BC) * v^2, so the coefficient is derivable at the reference muzzle Mach. No engine number is copied.
surfaces.ceiling: Load-time and global. One constant cannot follow the Mach-dependent drag over the whole flight; the value is calibrated at the muzzle Mach, where the vanilla values also sit.

surfaces.source: None held.
surfaces.reason: Tracer geometry is a rendering parameter, not a physical quantity. No committed corpus holds it, and the engine default is sound.
surfaces.ceiling: Low realism return. No sourced value.

surfaces.source: None held. The weapon corpus holds mass and twist, not measured group size.
surfaces.reason: dispersion is a cone of fire in the engine, not a measured group size, so a real Minuteman-of-angle cannot be mapped without inventing the conversion. No committed accuracy corpus exists.
surfaces.ceiling: Engine cone, not a group-size solver. A corpus of measured dispersion must land first.

surfaces.source: None held. No committed sight-adjustment corpus.
surfaces.reason: The real sight elevation range is a property of the sight, which is a separate optic class. No committed source holds the adjustment range per sight.
surfaces.ceiling: Per-scope, and no corpus. The runtime zeroing kernel owns the trajectory correction.

surfaces.source: The recoil corpus holds free recoil energy (weapons.json mass, loads.json muzzle velocity and charge, SAAMI formulae).
surfaces.reason: The CfgRecoils array is a fixed-shape camera-offset curve, not a physical impulse. Deriving the camera offsets from the impulse needs the engine's hidden mapping. AEE computes the richer physical recoil at run time (fnc_calculateRecoil.sqf).
surfaces.ceiling: The engine curve shape is engine-internal. The runtime kernel is richer.

surfaces.surface: CfgWeapons >> <optic> >> ItemInfo >> OpticsModes >> <mode> >> thermalMode[] / thermalNoise[] / thermalResolution[]
surfaces.source: addons/thermal/generated/ThermalOptics.hpp, from data/device/catalogue/thermal_devices.json.
surfaces.reason: The per-optic thermal keys are already overridden from the device corpus.
surfaces.ceiling: thermalMode[] is the engine-minimum palette pair WHOT (0) and BHOT (1).

surfaces.source: addons/mobility/generated/CfgVehicles.hpp, from data/physics/mass_calibration.json and the vehicle catalogue.
surfaces.reason: The calibrated mass and the held maximum speed are already overridden for 18 classes.
surfaces.ceiling: Load-time. The flight dynamics model is resolved at config load (ADR-017).

surfaces.source: STANAG 4569 protection levels L1 to L6 (docs/wiki/research/vehicle-armour-research.md).
surfaces.reason: armor is a health pool, not a ballistic gate: the formula (HIT*HIT)/Armor depletes with hits and is independent of the bisurf penetration gate. AEE resolves protection dynamically by design (fnc_getVehicleArmour). A static override would double-own the outcome.
surfaces.ceiling: Health pool, not penetration. The runtime kernel is the authority.

surfaces.source: None held. No committed braking corpus.
surfaces.reason: No committed source holds a stopping distance or a maximum service-brake deceleration per vehicle. A regulation-derived deceleration (UN ECE R13 or FMVSS 135) is a candidate source but is not yet held or mapped to the engine field.
surfaces.ceiling: No corpus. The engine field semantics must be pinned first.

surfaces.source: None held. The catalogue holds mass, tyre size and drivetrain, not a brake torque.
surfaces.reason: A brake torque can be derived from mass, a deceleration and the tyre radius, but the deceleration source and the engine field semantics are unproven. No value is invented.
surfaces.ceiling: Derived only once the deceleration source and the field semantics are pinned.

surfaces.source: Partial. The vehicle catalogue holds final_drive, gears and transmission_type for a minority of variants.
surfaces.reason: complexGearbox needs the per-gear ratios (GearboxRatios[]), which no committed source holds. The catalogue holds final_drive for 1 of 18 bound vehicles. A reopen with only finalDriveRatio is a near-empty override.
surfaces.ceiling: Per-gear ratios are unsourced. The catalogue must widen first.

surfaces.source: The AEE cloudlets exist (core AEE_SandCloud, AEE_SnowCloud; fx AEE_SupersonicTrace).
surfaces.reason: The effect binds a cloudlet to a named selection on the engine's destruction event. The vehicle-to-cloudlet and vehicle-to-selection mapping is authored and unsourced, and the AEE cloudlets are environment particles, not wreck smoke. No value is invented.
surfaces.ceiling: The engine owns the trigger. AEE can change the particles and the selection only.

surfaces.source: None held. No committed photometric (candela or lumen) corpus.
surfaces.reason: The engine brightness and intensity are tuning values, not candela, so a physical luminous intensity cannot be mapped without inventing the conversion. No committed photometric corpus exists.
surfaces.ceiling: Engine tuning units, no corpus. AEE sets lights at run time.

surfaces.source: The wildlife sound corpus exists (data/wildlife/asset_map.json) but holds no memory-point names.
surfaces.reason: The binding needs the memory-point names of the foliage models, which are not committed. The vanilla config is the only source, and a committed cache would be required. AEE's habitat audio is a runtime corpus by design.
surfaces.ceiling: No committed memory-point names. The runtime playback path already owns habitat audio.

surfaces.source: docs/wiki/research/soil-strength-nrmm.md holds verified laws (RCI = CI * RI, DCF), not a numeric friction table.
surfaces.reason: No committed friction corpus exists. The surface-to-terrain mapping is baked in the map surface mask, so a config override reaches only the friction scalar, and no sourced value is held for it.
surfaces.ceiling: No corpus. The map data is not config.

surfaces.surface: CfgWorlds >> DefaultWorld / CAWorld / <world> (HDRNewPars, DayLighting, starEmissivity, Grid)
surfaces.source: addons/environmental/config.cpp; docs/wiki/research/lighting-reference-review.md.
surfaces.reason: The HDR tone curve, the daylight keyframes and the star emissivity are already overridden.
surfaces.ceiling: The terrain heightmap and satellite imagery are terrain data, not config.

surfaces.source: docs/wiki/research/human-vision-model.md and ADR-014 bound a blur radius and a chromatic-aberration offset.
surfaces.reason: priority ordering is engine-global, so a config override changes every use of the effect. AEE applies optics effects through run-time ppEffect calls, where the per-frame context is known.
surfaces.ceiling: Engine-global priority. The runtime path owns the effect.

surfaces.source: addons/core/config.cpp (AEE_SandCloud, AEE_SnowCloud), addons/fx/config.cpp (AEE_SupersonicTrace); docs/wiki/research/particle-array-spec.md.
surfaces.reason: AEE authors its own cloudlets from the particle specification.
surfaces.ceiling: Re-authoring the vanilla smoke and dust cloudlets is available but not done.

surfaces.source: The wildlife sound corpus (data/wildlife/asset_map.json) holds sound-set material.
surfaces.reason: AEE's audio is a runtime corpus (wildlife, radio). A config sound set would fix the spatial model at load time, which the runtime path already varies. No value is invented.
surfaces.ceiling: Load-time spatial model, no per-biome config.

surfaces.source: addons/optics/config.cpp; docs/wiki/research/nato-symbology.md; ADR-023 and ADR-024.
surfaces.reason: The APP-6 marker set and the affiliation colours are already overridden.
surfaces.ceiling: The engine stretches a marker texture to the box and does not preserve aspect.

surfaces.source: addons/cartography/config_locationtypes.hpp; docs/wiki/research/terrain-symbols.md.
surfaces.reason: The terrain symbols are already overridden from the topographic standard.
surfaces.ceiling: None at config level.

surfaces.source: addons/cartography/config_mapcolors.hpp, config_mapicons.hpp and config_mapdisplays.hpp; docs/wiki/research/map-grid-and-cursor-surface.md.
surfaces.reason: The map palette and the display subclasses are already overridden.
surfaces.ceiling: Eden's map is ctrlMap, not RscMapControl, so a RscMapControl reopen does not reach Eden.

surfaces.source: addons/cartography/config_curator.hpp; ADR-023.
surfaces.reason: The five side textures and the 3D and 2D sub-blocks are already overridden.
surfaces.ceiling: The texture is per side, not per unit function.

surfaces.source: addons/physiology/config.cpp; ASA/ASHRAE 55 and ISO 11079 clo, DLA NIR reflectance.
surfaces.reason: CfgClothing is an AEE-authored class, not a base engine class, and it is already declared. The engine ignores it.
surfaces.ceiling: Not an engine class. AEE convention only.

surfaces.source: docs/wiki/research/arma-font-surface.md (Rajdhani, B612 Mono).
surfaces.reason: The family is asset-gated: no .fxy or .paa glyph files ship, so the engine draws no text for it. The FontToTGA step needs Windows. No value is invented.
surfaces.ceiling: Asset-gated. The family is inert until the glyphs ship.

surfaces.source: None.
surfaces.reason: The object-to-icon routing for vehicles is engine-internal. A reopen reaches only the keys the engine already reads, and the realism return is low.
surfaces.ceiling: Engine-internal routing.

surfaces.source: None.
surfaces.reason: An animation override needs matching animation assets (.rtm files) and a skeleton match. A value-only reopen changes timing, not motion. CfgMovesAnimations is not a base class.
surfaces.ceiling: Asset-gated. Rejected unless AEE ships animations.
